description: This file defines API handlers for searching channels and boards within a team or globally, including route registration and search logic with permission checks and audit logging.

classes.name: API
classes.description: Struct representing the API with methods for search route handling.

methods.name: registerSearchRoutes
methods.description: Registers search-related HTTP routes to the provided router.

methods.name: handleSearchMyChannels
methods.description: Handles search requests for user's channels within a team.

methods.name: handleSearchBoards
methods.description: Handles search requests for boards within a team based on a search term.

methods.name: handleSearchLinkableBoards
methods.description: Handles search requests for boards that the user can manage within a team.

methods.name: handleSearchAllBoards
methods.description: Handles global search requests for boards.
